name: 异世界访客
description: 玩家本人的身份卡，PvP 中使用：可以使用任何技能卡，但没有任何加成。
descriptionEn: Your own identity card, used in PvP: can use any skill card, but with no bonuses.

name: 学者
description: 图书馆的 NPC：鉴定古老的卡牌，用相同卡牌生成制作秘方。
descriptionEn: Library NPC: appraises ancient cards and turns duplicates into crafting recipes.

name: 铸造师
description: 熔炉的 NPC：把卡牌熔炼成魔晶石，用秘方和原料铸造新卡。
descriptionEn: Forge NPC: melts cards into magic stones and crafts new cards from recipes.

name: 召唤师
description: 可招募：除通用技能卡外，还可以使用召唤技能卡，召唤有独立血量的召唤物并肩作战。
descriptionEn: Recruitable: besides common skill cards, can use summon skill cards to call forth summons with their own HP.

name: 火魔法师
description: 可招募：火系魔法师，专属技能卡附带灼烧效果。
descriptionEn: Recruitable fire mage; exclusive skill cards apply burn.

name: 水魔法师
description: 可招募：水系魔法师，专属技能卡偏治疗与护盾。
descriptionEn: Recruitable water mage; exclusive skill cards focus on healing and shields.

name: 雷魔法师
description: 可招募：雷系魔法师，专属技能卡偏先手与连锁伤害。
descriptionEn: Recruitable thunder mage; exclusive skill cards favor initiative and chain damage.

name: 冰魔法师
description: 可招募：冰系魔法师，专属技能卡附带冻结效果。
descriptionEn: Recruitable ice mage; exclusive skill cards apply freeze.

name: 土魔法师
description: 可招募：土系魔法师，专属技能卡偏护盾与嘲讽。
descriptionEn: Recruitable earth mage; exclusive skill cards focus on shields and taunt.

name: 哥布林王
description: 传送门里的 boss，玩家无法招募。会召唤哥布林仆从。
descriptionEn: A portal boss that players cannot recruit. Summons goblin minions.

name: 雪山霜巨人
description: 更强的传送门 boss，玩家无法招募。冰系冻结攻击。
descriptionEn: A stronger portal boss that players cannot recruit. Ice freeze attacks.
